name: Amazon Quick Web Crawler
description: The web crawler AWS runs for Amazon Quick, which fetches the website content an AWS customer has configured as a data source and indexes it into that customer's knowledge base. Like the Bedrock and Q Business crawlers it is customer-directed but operator-run. AWS documents that it respects the robots.txt protocol, honours user-agent, allow, disallow and crawl-delay fields, reads robots.txt per host, and that it crawls anyway when robots.txt cannot be fetched because of blocking, parsing errors or timeouts.
